import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import mlx.core as mx
from mlxlearn._kernels.e_means_bf16 import assign_bf16,prepare_centers
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
records=[]
for n,k,d in [(1,1,1),(9,67,11),(37,131,96),(67,71,100),(67,133,129),(35,65,3072)]:
 x=mx.array(rng.standard_normal((n,d),dtype=np.float32)).astype(mx.bfloat16)
 c=mx.array(rng.standard_normal((k,d),dtype=np.float32)).astype(mx.bfloat16)
 xn=np.asarray(x.astype(mx.float32)).astype(np.float64);cn=np.asarray(c.astype(mx.float32)).astype(np.float64)
 for sph in [False,True]:
  labels,scores=assign_bf16(x,c,spherical=sph,batch_size=17)
  lab=np.asarray(labels);actual=np.asarray(scores)
  dist=-(xn@cn.T) if sph else np.sum(cn*cn,axis=1)-2*(xn@cn.T)
  wanted=np.argmin(dist,axis=1)
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(lab,wanted)
  np.testing.assert_allclose(actual,dist[np.arange(n),wanted],rtol=3e-6,atol=2e-4)
  records.append({'n':n,'k':k,'d':d,'spherical':sph,'mismatches':int(np.count_nonzero(lab!=wanted)),'max_score_error':float(np.max(abs(actual-dist[np.arange(n),wanted])))})
x=mx.array([[100000.,200000.,-300000.],[0.,0.,0.]],dtype=mx.float32)
c=mx.array([[100000.,200000.,-300000.],[100000.,200000.,-300000.],[0.,0.,0.]],dtype=mx.float32)
labels,scores=assign_bf16(x,c);np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.asarray(labels),[0,2]);assert np.isfinite(np.asarray(scores)).all()
source=Path('src/mlxlearn/_kernels/e_means_bf16.py').read_bytes()
Path('benchmarks/e_means/results/optimization/bf16-production-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'command':'PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python /tmp/e_means_bf16_smoke.py','checks':records,'large_finite_and_lowest_tie_index_pass':True},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Production BF16 smoke passed: 12 ragged/spherical oracle cases, chunking, >FP16 range, smallest-index tie')
